'''Verena Meyer''' (4 June 1929 – 21 July 2018) was a Swiss nuclear physicist and former President of the [[University of Zurich]]. She was the first woman elected to serve as president of the [[Swiss Physical Society]].

==Early life==
Meyer was born to academic parents in 1929. Her father, Karl Meyer, was a professor of history at the University of Zurich and her mother, Alice Meyer, was a lawyer.<ref name = "x">{{cite web |last1=Werner |first1=David |title=Death of Former UZH President Verena Meyer |url=https://www.news.uzh.ch/en/articles/2018/verena-meyer.html |website=news.uzh.ch |accessdate=25 October 2019 |date=27 July 2018}}</ref> Her father died when she was 20 years old.<ref name = "Werner">{{cite web |last1=Werner |first1=David |title=Ich nahm das Leben, wie es kam |url=https://www.higgs.ch/ich-nahm-das-leben-wie-es-kam/16958/ |website=higgs.ch |accessdate=25 October 2019 |language=German |date=16 December 2019}}</ref>

==Career==
She originally entered medical school, but eventually switch to physics at the University of Zurich.<ref>{{cite web |title=Verena Meyer – eine Physikerin als Pionierin Zum 70. Geburtstag der Präsidentin des Wissenschaftsrats |url=https://www.uzh.ch/cmsssl/physik/dam/jcr:6a96bc1f-9cff-436b-9d30-38de29ab582f/NZZ_19990604_16.pdf |website=uzh.ch |accessdate=25 October 2019 |language=German |date=4 June 1999}}</ref> She was influenced to make the change due to nuclear physicist Hans H. Staub.<ref name = "Werner"/>

After conducting her postdoctorate at the University of Minnesota, she returned to the University of Zurich as a professor.<ref name = "Wehrli">{{cite news |last1=Wehrli |first1=Christopher |title=Verena Meyer – Nachruf auf eine aussergewöhnliche Wissenschafterin |url=https://www.nzz.ch/zuerich/taten-fuer-die-ganze-wissenschaft-ld.1407227 |accessdate=25 October 2019 |publisher=[[Neue Zürcher Zeitung]] |date=27 July 2018 |language=German}}</ref> Her work in Minnesota, which was a collaborative project with the University of Zurich, focused on the construction of a particle accelerator.<ref name = "Werner"/> She began her career at the University of Zurich as a lecturer before being promoted to full professor. She served in various roles until her retirement in 1994, such as Dean of the Philosophical Faculty II and Vice-President of Research.<ref>{{cite web |title=Nachruf Prof. Dr. Verena Meyer |url=https://www.sps.ch/en/archive/nachrufe/nachruf-prof-dr-verena-meyer/ |website=sps.ch |accessdate=25 October 2019 |language=German}}</ref>

She was the first woman elected to serve as president of the [[Swiss Physical Society]], which she held from 1975 until 1979.<ref>{{cite book |last1=Zschokke-Granacher |first1=Iris |title=AIP Conference Proceedings |chapter=Women in Physics in Switzerland |date=2002|volume=628 |pages=227–228 |doi=10.1063/1.1505345 }}</ref> In 1976, Meyer was appointed dean of the Faculty of Science, become the first woman told hold such a position. She went on to serve as President of the university from 1982 to 1984.<ref name = "x"/> During the same year she was promoted to Dean, the Faculty of Law and Political Science also promoted another female, Heidi Schelbert, to the same position. Meyer stated she felt there was a competition between the department to bring prestige to the university.<ref>{{cite web |title=† Prof. Dr. Verena Meyer |url=https://www.gleichstellung.uzh.ch/de/politik/em-professorinnen/verenameyer.html |website=gleichstellung.uzh.ch |accessdate=25 October 2019 |language=German}}</ref> She later sat as President of the Swiss Science Council from 1987 to 2000.<ref name = "Wehrli"/><ref>{{cite web |title=From Science Council to Innovation Council |url=https://www.swir.ch/images/stories/pdf/en/SWIR_Schrift_4_2015_E_From_Science_Council_to_Innovation_Council_web.pdf |website=swir.cj |accessdate=25 October 2019 |page=24 |date=2015}}</ref> She also was a member of the Energy Research Commission for the federal government.<ref>{{cite web |title=Verena Meyer |url=https://hls-dhs-dss.ch/de/articles/041693/2009-11-10/ |website=hls-dhs-dss.ch |accessdate=25 October 2019 |date=2009}}</ref>

She died on 21 July 2018.<ref>{{cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Verena Meyer, emeritierte Professorin für Experimentalphysik und Rektorin der Universität Zürich von 1982 bis 1984 |url=https://www.news.uzh.ch/de/topics/in_memoriam/2018/Verena-Meyer.html |website=news.uzh.ch |accessdate=25 October 2019 |language=German |date=2018}}</ref>
